Task H2: Lease fencing and concurrent claims


Implement Queue as a thread-safe in-memory queue with a lock; injected numeric now, no sleeps.
add(job_id) adds a queued record once. claim(worker, now, ttl) atomically returns a lease dict
{job_id,worker,token} or None. Eligible: queued or running whose expiry <= now. IDs chosen in insertion order.
Every claim gets a NEW unique token, including reclaim by the same worker. ttl must be >0.
renew(lease, now, ttl) and complete(lease, now) return boolean; only exact current token/worker
with expiry > now may act. renew extends expiry to now+ttl. completed jobs never reclaim.
Caller mutation of returned lease must not alter internal state. Preserve class and method signatures.


Work only inside the supplied workspace. Use Python standard library only. Inspect the files, implement the requirements, run available checks, and give a short final report describing changes and checks actually performed. Do not modify TASK.md, smoke.py or the evaluation infrastructure. Do not install packages or access the internet. Do not claim a check passed without running it.

import queueing
import threading
import time

def test_queue_operations():
    q = queueing.Queue()
    q.add(1)
    q.add(2)
    q.add(3)
    now = 1000
    ttl = 50

    # Test claim
    lease1 = q.claim('worker1', now, ttl)
    assert lease1 is not None
    assert lease1['job_id'] == 1
    assert lease1['worker'] == 'worker1'
    assert lease1['token'] is not None

    # Test renew
    assert q.renew(lease1, now + 25, ttl) == True
    assert q.renew(lease1, now + 25, ttl) == True
    assert q.renew(lease1, now + 100, ttl) == False  # Expired

    # Test complete
    assert q.complete(lease1, now + 25) == True
    assert q.complete(lease1, now + 25) == False  # Already completed

    # Test claim again after completion
    lease2 = q.claim('worker1', now, ttl)
    assert lease2 is not None
    assert lease2['job_id'] == 2

    # Test claim with different worker
    lease3 = q.claim('worker2', now, ttl)
    assert lease3 is not None
    assert lease3['job_id'] == 3

    # Test renew with wrong token
    wrong_lease = {'job_id': 1, 'worker': 'worker1', 'token': 'wrong_token'}
    assert q.renew(wrong_lease, now + 25, ttl) == False

    # Test complete with wrong token
    assert q.complete(wrong_lease, now + 25) == False

def test_concurrent_claims():
    q = queueing.Queue()
    q.add(1)
    q.add(2)
    q.add(3)
    now = 1000
    ttl = 50

    def worker(worker_id, q, now, ttl):
        lease = q.claim(worker_id, now, ttl)
        if lease:
            assert lease['worker'] == worker_id
            assert q.renew(lease, now + 25, ttl) == True
            assert q.complete(lease, now + 25) == True

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker, args=('worker'+str(i), q, now, ttl)) for i in range(3)]
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    for t in threads:
        t.join()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_queue_operations()
    test_concurrent_claims()
    print('All tests passed.')
